story.title: UK's NCSC warns AI-powered bug hunting will unleash a patch tsunami of long-buried code vulnerabilities
story.summary: Britain's National Cyber Security Centre has issued a warning that AI-assisted vulnerability discovery is rapidly surfacing decades of previously undetected software flaws, creating a wave of urgent patches that security teams will struggle to absorb. The agency says years of accumulated technical debt in codebases — shortcuts and legacy decisions made by developers under time pressure — are now being exposed at machine speed. Organisations are advised to prioritise patch management infrastructure and incident response capacity before the volume of disclosures overwhelms them.
